title: Use contraction with the correct conditional initial-distance debit
statement: The fixed contractive program carries average conditional initial Wasserstein error and the local row-TV debit into a uniform-in-deterministic-macrostep floor. Same-start distance is zero; arbitrary preparation has upper bound one. An unconditional marginal initial distance is insufficient when the retained record selects the subsequent kernel.

assumptions: The general old-record extension needs average CONDITIONAL initial Wasserstein distance, not unconditional marginal distance. Static hidden parameters, conditionally fresh native increments, actual isolation, accurate label reads and protected/paid latency are premises.
